posts.name: Bhavya Sheth
posts.cooked:
Hello Sir,

Due to issues with my laptop I was not able to submit my BPT - 3 on time . I have submitted within 10 minutes after the deadline as my laptop had just got rectified. I request you to consider my submission for evaluation as it is essential for me to get marks in this BPT in order to qualify for the OPPE. This is my last subject and I hope to complete it in this term so that I can move on to the Degree level.

Kindly reconsider and award me marks for the same as it is the only way for me to be eligible for the OPPE. I promise to submit the next BPT well before the deadline.

Thank you

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: It is not possible to make exceptions in a case by case basis. The entire process is automated and the same deadline applies for all. Relaxing for one makes it unfair for others with similar issues which might not have been voiced. Deadlines exist for a reason, it is the one unifying rule that keeps the system fair for all. The deadlines have had been shared from release date, it is hard to believe one could not have submitted in the entire span of the week when the assignment was open. Also, how can one submit four programming questions in 10 minutes is questionable, solving each question usually takes 10-20 minutes each if done by oneself. Even if you could not attempt all four before deadline, however many you did attempt will be considered. If you mean you submitted none before deadline and all after 10 minutes of deadline, then that irks suspicions of copy-paste. I can understand your concern about this being your last subject in diploma level, and if you are not qualified you will have to re-take this subject alone next term, however rules are not changed based on individual inconveniences. You ought to be more careful than that. Also, if you do have to repeat this next term, i would recommend repeating some other course too which you performed poorly in, to fully utilize the term and improve your CGPA

posts.name: Khustar
posts.cooked:
i understand the need for strict deadlines to keep things fair. here i want to share a concern regarding this situation.

this is not about asking for a special exception, but about how submissions work in practice. many students, including me, submit close to the deadline because of other commitments. i had planned to submit before the deadline, as i usually do.

if many students try to submit at the same time and the system slows down or fails, it puts students at a disadvantage even if they are following the deadline properly. there was no prior instruction advising us to submit before the deadline to avoid such issues.

if deadlines are enforced strictly, the system should also remain reliable until the last moment. otherwise, students who act in good faith may still get penalized.

for those who had similar issues but may not have voiced them, kindly consider extending the deadline by 1–2 hours. if extensions were possible in earlier terms, then it may be reasonable to consider it here as well.
